name: Xoi
summary: Xôi is dense sticky rice, savoury or sweet. Savoury xôi mặn is an inexpensive Hanoi breakfast, the sweet side runs to more than 20 kinds, and Xôi Yến in Hoàn Kiếm is the classic door.
origin: Hanoi, where Xôi Yến in Hoàn Kiếm is the classic door. Da Nang eats it at breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
howToEat: Xôi mặn is the savoury breakfast. Xôi ngọt is the sweet side, with more than 20 kinds.
Xôi ngũ sắc, five-colour sticky rice, is purple, green, red, yellow, and white, coloured with plant extracts.
In Da Nang, eat it in the morning on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
where: Xôi Yến, 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân, Lý Thái Tổ, Hoàn Kiếm.
In Da Nang, Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in the morning, busiest from 06:00 to 08:00, with stalls until about 12:00.
seoDescription: Xôi in Hanoi is dense sticky rice, savoury at breakfast or sweet, with more than 20 sweet kinds. Xôi Yến is at 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân.
